name: Immortal Heart Society
source: Summoned by a strange invitation, you and your estranged sibling find yourselves at the center of a shadowy secret society who claim to run the world. Delving into its mysteries, you discover the powerful inner circle whose members have the power to travel through time...and they want you to join them! Play as either the heroine or her brother as you discover a world of obscure rituals, family skeletons, and timeless love.
translation: 一封奇怪的邀请函，将你与你关系疏远的手足，带到了一个神秘秘密结社的中心。这个结社声称掌控着整个世界。深入探究其中的谜团，你发现，它的核心成员拥有穿越时间的力量……而他们希望你也加入！选择扮演女主角，或她的兄弟，走进一个充满隐秘仪式、家族丑闻与跨越时间的爱情的世界。
